# MathJax

Version: 3.2.2. License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/mathjax/-/mathjax-3.2.2.tgz

Only the `es5/tex-svg.js` browser bundle is included. Figure Studio loads it locally on demand with base, AMS and newcommand support, automatic page typesetting disabled and SVG font caching disabled. No runtime CDN or TeX installation is needed.

Documentation: https://docs.mathjax.org/en/v3.2/options/output/svg.html
